description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waradala Diulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510001 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in various villages. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
